description: Xuan Kong flying star natal chart: nine palaces with mountain/facing/period stars plus classical pattern labels (e.g. 旺山旺向). Period from a construction date, or explicit yun

date.description: when yun is omitted: the construction date whose period is used

sitting.description: sitting mountain: index 0–23 or Chinese name 子癸丑艮寅甲卯乙辰巽巳丙午丁未坤申庚酉辛戌乾亥壬

yun.description: period 1–9; omit to use the period of the reference date
